Overview

Bologna is a city in Emilia-Romagna with a population of 392,000. Italy’s culinary capital, home to the world’s oldest university, with iconic porticoes, rich red-hued architecture, and a vibrant food scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
